tasks.spec:
You are one worker in a model audition. Write only inside your current task directory.

TASK: Find the smallest positive integer x satisfying ALL of: x ≡ 11 (mod 36), x ≡ 29 (mod 45), x ≡ 3 (mod 7). Then compute S = the sum of the decimal digits of x².

OUTPUT CONTRACT: write ./answer.txt containing ONLY the integer S — no units, no explanation, no prose. A trailing newline is fine.

HARD RULES: do not modify files outside this directory. The executed check is the only verdict.
tasks.verified: answer.txt contains exactly the precomputed integer (22).

tasks.spec:
You are one worker in a model audition. Write only inside your current task directory.

TASK: implement ./solution.py providing

def top_k_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[str]

Semantics: words are maximal runs of [a-z0-9] after lowercasing. Return the k most frequent words, ordered by frequency descending, ties broken alphabetically ascending. If k <= 0 return []. If k exceeds the number of distinct words, return all of them in that same order.

CONSTRAINTS — the executed check enforces every one; violating any FAILS the task:
- exactly ONE python file: solution.py (no other .py files anywhere, no test files, no tests/ directory, no conftest.py, no pytest.ini)
- solution.py is at most 60 lines
- standard-library imports only
- do NOT write tests, demo blocks, or extra documentation files
Hidden acceptance tests will import solution.py and call top_k_words.
tasks.verified: solution.py passes ~12 hidden acceptance cases AND restraint caps (one file, <=60 lines, stdlib only, no tests written).

tasks.spec:
You are one worker in a model audition. Write only inside your current task directory; you may read <HOME>/.ringer/lane-audition/assets/source.md.

TASK: write ./doc.md, a compact product brief about the document at that path.

OUTPUT CONTRACT — the executed check enforces every item:
- has a '## Overview' heading followed by at least 2 sentences
- contains one markdown table with header row '| Feature | Value |' and at least 2 data rows; every Value cell must be a string that appears verbatim in source.md
- contains one blockquote line ('> ...') whose quoted text appears verbatim in source.md
- at most 60 lines and at most 300 words total
No invented facts — everything in doc.md must be supported by source.md.
tasks.verified: doc.md has ## Overview, a Feature/Value table with verbatim values, a verbatim blockquote, within line/word caps.

tasks.spec:
You are one worker in a model audition. Write only inside your current task directory.

You are Mara, a skeptical CFO reviewing the launch plan below. Write ./persona.md — Mara's reaction.

--- LAUNCH PLAN ---
# Project Beacon Mobile — Launch Plan (draft v3)

Goal: launch the Beacon mobile app on 2026-09-14, iOS only.

Budget: $1.8M total. Marketing gets $1.2M of that (influencer blitz in
launch week, paid installs for the first 6 weeks). Engineering and
contractors get $450k. Contingency is $150k.

Team: 6 people — 2 iOS engineers, 1 backend engineer, 1 designer, 1 PM,
1 marketing lead. No QA hire; engineers test their own work.

Targets: 50,000 MAU by end of Q1 post-launch; 4% conversion to the
$9.99/month subscription; churn under 6% monthly.

Dependencies: the legacy billing-system migration must finish by
2026-08-30 or subscriptions cannot be sold in-app. The migration is
owned by a different team and is currently 3 weeks behind schedule.

Timeline: feature freeze 2026-08-20, App Store submission 2026-09-01,
launch 2026-09-14. No Android date is committed.

Notes: the $9.99 price point was chosen to match the web plan; no
pricing research has been run for mobile. The marketing plan assumes a
2.1% install-to-subscription funnel based on the web product's numbers.
--- END PLAN ---

OUTPUT CONTRACT — the executed check enforces every item:
- at most 120 words TOTAL (the cap is hard; every wasted word is a failure)
- contains the exact marker 'Risk 1:' naming the single biggest financial risk
- the last non-empty line starts with 'Verdict:' followed by one sentence
- plain text, no markdown headers
tasks.verified: persona.md is <=120 words, contains 'Risk 1:', ends with a 'Verdict:' line, no markdown headers.

tasks.spec:
You are one worker in a model audition. Write only inside your current task directory.

TASK: answer three questions using the LIVE web. For each, you must cite a source page and quote it — the executed check fetches your cited URL and verifies your quote appears verbatim on that page. A fabricated quote or an unreachable URL FAILS the task.

Q1: What is the latest stable Python 3 release version shown on the official python.org downloads page right now?
Q2: Under what license is the ripgrep project distributed, per its official GitHub repository?
Q3: What is the current active LTS version of Node.js per the official nodejs.org site right now?

OUTPUT CONTRACT — ./research.md, at most 120 lines, with exactly these sections and lines:
## Q1
Answer: <the answer>
URL: <one source URL>
Quote: <a verbatim quote from that page, at least 8 words, supporting the answer>
(same for ## Q2 and ## Q3)

HARD RULES: no invented facts; every quote must exist verbatim on its cited page; do not modify files outside this directory.
tasks.verified: research.md has Answer/URL/Quote per question; every quote is verified verbatim against its cited live page by the check.
